balls.text: slower short ball on the stumps, and Tewatia finishes with a boundary! Sits up nicely and Tewatia has all the time in the world to muscle it between deep square leg and fine leg. Four to finish the innings, and GT get up to 168!

skewed a mile up, and Kishan lunges forward to gobble it up! What a grab! Off-pace and into the track on middle and off. Sundar does not pick the variation and is a week early into the stroke. Swipes at it anyway and the ball goes straight up. Kishan charges after it and dives forward to complete the catch in the square leg region. Top effort, but take nothing away from a top Sundar knock either!
slot ball just outside off but Holder cannot get under it. Shanks it all along the ground to long on, and he has to settle for a single
slower ball bashed in short just outside off. Sundar, looking for the scoop, gets into an awkward tangle. Somehow helps it past short fine leg and brings up a 32-ball fifty!
low full toss just outside off. Seems to tail in a touch and Holder digs it out towards extra cover

slower ball hung up on a length wide outside off. Holder too early into his swish and misses, but the line means he gets the wide call. But hang on. SRH have reviewed the wide call. More in hope, by the looks of it. But some time will be taken out of the game courtesy the review. Holder has taken a small step across his stumps but the ball is still beyond the revised guideline. Wide call stays!
just over! Full just outside off. Holder looks to go inside-out but the bat face opens upon contact. Sliced over extra cover for a brace

my goodness - this is a shot and a half! Malinga misses his leg-stump yorker again - this time on the fuller side. Sundar bends his back knee, falls to the turf while playing the shot but somehow still shovels it over deep square leg. Incredible!
sensational shot! Almost a yorker, on middle and off. Sundar shuffles across, gets down low, ends up on the deck and still laps it over short fine!
very full on off. Holder cannot get under this either and drills it to long off
slower bumper outside off and this balloons past the batter. Left alone by Holder and called a wide
brilliant bowling. Very full on middle and leg. Sundar clears his front leg and jams it out towards long on. Holder happy to come back for the second but Sundar is not as interested
Sundar motoring along now! Dug in short on the stumps and this sits up too. Sundar sets up for the pull and muscles it to deep backward square leg's right!
well, that will go down as a drop! Not sure how much Malinga knew about that. Full toss outside off. Holder belts it back at the bowler, who gets his right hand to it and parries it towards long on
low full toss just outside off. Holder opens up his stance and powers it down the ground to long on
another nicely-executed yorker, just outside off. Sundar chalks it out towards extra cover
banged in much shorter on middle and off. Sundar looks to upper-cut it but fails to lay bat on ball. Not called a wide and Sundar opts against reviewing
that has flown to the fence! Shortish outside off, bowled from around the wicket. Sundar gives himself ample room and blitzes it through point!
top yorker to follow up the first ball. Just outside off and Holder clinks it out to long on
hard length, just outside off. Holder opens up his stance and swings for the hills. Only connects with the fresh Ahmedabad air
Sundar gets one away! Sakib misses the leg-stump yorker and Sundar takes full toll. He gets his front foot out of the way and muscles it past mid wicket!
very similar to the previous ball. Very full but also sneaking down leg. Some more exercise for the umpire as Sundar misses his flick
another brilliant yorker but the line is a touch awry. Down leg and an easy decision for the umpire once Sundar misses his sweep
right up in the blockhole on leg. Sundar cannot do much with it and digs it out towards mid wicket. He accessed the ball through his legs there
zipped in full and wide. Holder reaches out for it and jabs it towards sweeper cover
slower thigh-high full toss on the stumps. Holder nurdles it into the square leg region and gets off the mark with a brace

Sudharsan tries to be funky, and pays the price! Well, to be fair to him, GT needed an injection of momentum. Yorker on leg and Sudharsan tries to reverse-lap it. Does not get into a good enough position (neither low enough, nor with the requisite room), and he plonks it to short third. Hinge with a slightly unconventional catching technique but he holds on!
full outside off. Sundar sits deep in his crease and drills it to long off
low full toss on leg. Sundar brings his wrists into play and flicks it past mid wicket to retain strike
full toss on the pads. Sundar looks to sweep it away behind square but fails to make contact. Impact would have been outside leg
slow and short outside off. Sundar stays back, winds up and slaps it on the bounce to long off, where Abhishek does enough to stop the boundary
very full on middle and off. Sudharsan cannot get under it and jams it out to long off
four more! Bumper outside off but no real venom on this. Sudharsan gets on top of the bounce nicely and hammers it over mid wicket!
zipped in full on middle and leg. Sundar comes forward and pushes it to long on
another top yorker, zoning into middle and leg. Sundar clinks it out into the mid wicket region and keeps strike
excellent yorker, outside off. Sundar looks to squeeze it out behind point but is late on the stroke. Only scrapes a piece of the turf for his troubles
slower short ball outside off. Sudharsan goes back and pulls it towards deep mid wicket
very full on off. Sundar gets his bat down in time and digs it out towards backward point
full toss outside off and Sundar nearly pops it straight to extra cover. Tried to find the gap but was unable to do so
this is a terrific shot! Back of a length outside off. Sundar tranfsers his weight forward, stands up tall and caresses it over extra cover!
safe, just! Floated up full just outside off. Sundar looks to go downtown but cloths it. Thankfully for him, it lands in front of long on
short, wide and punished! Sundar picks the leg-spinner and waits for it deep in his crease before slapping it past extra cover!
flighted up full outside off. Sudharsan gets onto the front foot and drags it towards deep mid wicket
fired in full on the pads. Sudharsan dinks it into the vast open spaces in the square leg region and saunters back for two
right in the gap, and Sudharsan brings up another fifty - his sixth this season! Pushed in full on middle and leg. Sudharsan gets down on one knee and belts it between deep square leg and fine leg!
darted into the blockhole on middle and leg. Sundar gets his front foot out of the way and clinks it out to long on
hard length, honing into the stumps. No room to work with this time and Sudharsan pokes it to mid wicket
back of a length, angling across the batter outside off. Sudharsan wafts at it but is beaten for pace
full on middle and off. Sundar plants his front foot and scuffs it to long off. Was looking to go downtown
back of a length just outside off. Sudharsan waits on it and runs it down to deep third
clean strike! Slower ball and this lands right in the slot outside off. Sudharsan bends his back knee, gets under it and hoists it over mid off!
length ball on the pads. Sudharsan comes forward and helps it just behind square for a couple of runs
googly on a back of a length just outside off. Sundar opts to hang back and chops it off his stumps towards backward point
googly, floated up full just outside off. Sudharsan comes onto the front foot and turns it towards deep backward square leg
back of a length outside off. Sundar hangs back and jabs it down the ground towards long on
back of a length outside off. Pushed out to extra cover
googly on a length on off. Sudharsan picks it off the pitch, stays back, and nudges it towards deep backward square leg
slanted down leg again. Sudharsan pulls out of his glance at the last moment and gets another wide
slides this well down leg. Sudharsan lets it go and the umpire signals for a wide
leg-spinner on a back of a length on off. Spins away a touch and Sundar works it towards deep squsre leg
oh no! Full outside off. Sudharsan plants his front foot and smashes it straight back. Sundar, in trying to regain his ground, inadvertently stops it and saves four for SRH!
Sudharsan breaks the shackles! Dragged down and this finishes outside off. Sudharsan skips down the track, throws his hands at it and carves it over backward point!
slower yorker outside off. Drops on the batter late and Sudharsan does well to squeeze it out past extra cover. Back for a couple of runs
fuller outside off. Sundar presses onto the front foot and knocks it to long off
length outside off. Sudharsan stays on top of the bounce and drives it enough to mid off's right for a single
zipped in full on the stumps. Sudharsan comes half forward and stabs it towards mid wicket
back of a length on middle and off. SUndar gets up on his toes and pushes it towards mid on
back of a length in the channel and this straightens against the angle. Sundar nibbles at it and gets beaten all ends up
Sundar is up and running! Over-pitched just outside off and Sundar capitalizes. He uses his reach to get under it and lifts it nicely over mid on!

launched straight to long off, and Sindhu has to trudge off! Fullish outside off and this is there to be lofted. Sindhu, though, tries to take on the sweeper and on this sluggish track, that is fraught with danger. Chips it straight down Klaasen's throat, and Sindhu has to walk back after a sprightly cameo!
dug in with greater conviction, on middle and leg. Sudharsan rolls his wrists over it to an extent and pulls it towards deep backward square leg
back of a length outside off. Sudharsan throws his hands at it and chops it off the under-edge towards the keeper
slower ball on a back of a length on middle and leg. Sudharsan nudges it into the square leg region and keeps strike
dug in shorter outside off. Sudharsan shapes for the pull but picks out the fielder at mid wicket
gorgeous! Full enough outside off and that is all Sudharsan needs. He rocks forward and cracks it past extra cover!
shortish on the stumps. Sindhu opens up his stance and hacks it to deep mid wicket
back of a length just outside off. Sindhu hangs back and pats it towards extra cover
back of a length on the stumps. Sudharsan gets up on his toes and turns it past mid wicket
slower ball on a back of a length on middle and leg. Sudharsan backs away and dabs it towards sweeper cover
low full toss speared into the pads. Sudharsan works it past mid wicket and has enough time to canter back for two
back of a length on middle and leg. Sindhu drops it towards extra cover and scampers across to the other end
on a length in the channel and this seams away a touch. Sindhu looks to drive on the up and gets beaten on the outside
short again, tucking up the batter outside leg. Sudharsan helps it down to fine leg
welcomed with a boundary! Shortish outside off and Sudharsan pounces. He rises with the bounce and knifes it past backward point!
up and over again! Right in the slot outside off and Sindhu makes merry. He plants his front foot and pops it over mid off!
back of a length on middle and off. Sindhu gets up on his toes and defends

almost a brilliant catch! Another short ball, finishing just outside off. Sindhu waits on it and ramps it towards deep third, who is very fine. Hinge takes it while jumping over his right shoulder but as he realizes he will step out of bounds, he parries it back into play. Saves four in the end
right out of the screws! Banged in short on off, but at 133.4kph, it is fodder for Sindhu. He rocks back and whacks it over deep mid wicket!
full and wide outside off. Sudharsan throws his hands at it and slices it uppishly towards deep point
hard length, zoning into middle and off. Gets a little big on the batter, who scuffs it towards extra cover
shot! Back of a length outside off. Sindhu marches down the track, stands tall and crashes it over extra cover!
dug into the track again, outside off. Sindhu, almost as an afterthought, tries the upper-cut and misses
full just outside off, coming in with the angle from around the wicket. Sindhu comes forward and defends
off the mark in pristine fashion! Hinge goes for the old two-card trick, and pushes this full and wide. Sindhu, though, gets a good stride in and cracks it on the up to cover point's right!
banged in short on middle and off, bowled from around the wicket. Comes in with the angle and Sindhu is happy to sway out of the way

appeal for a caught-behind, but the umpire responds with a wide call! And SRH review. Full and sneaking a touch down leg. Buttler shapes for the scoop and shuffles across, and Kishan and the bowler think there is bat involved. And they are fully correct. Clear spike when the ball is next to the bat, and Buttler has to go!
Sudharsan fails in executing the scoop now! Back of a length on middle and leg. Sudharsan falls down to the turf, trying to get it over short fine and fails to make contact
hard length on middle and leg. Sudharsan gets a little squared up and plonks it into the off side
fullish just outside off. Sudharsan gets onto the front foot and drives it to mid off
well well! Back of a length outside off. Buttler shapes for the scoop but makes a hash of it. The ball pings off his body into the off side
zipped in full just outside off. Buttler steps down but has to take swift action to keep it out. Jams it off the inside edge into his pad
sloppy in the field! Full and spearing into the pads. Buttler maintains his balance and flicks it powerfully past mid wicket. Not a great effort. Sakib did not get down low enough to his right!
hard length, angling into middle and off. Sudharsan, having advanced, is tucked up for room and drops it into the on side
back of a length on middle and leg. Buttler helps it behind square, albeit off the thigh pad
shortish outside off and seaming away. Buttler wafts at it but only grabs a handful of fresh air. Not called a wide either
back of a length outside off. Buttler opts to let it go
fuller outside off and this moves away slightly. Buttler goes fishing at it and pushes it towards deep backward point
back of a length on off. Sudharsan rises with the bounce and jabs it towards deep backward point
peach! Back of a length in the sixth stump channel and this straightens a touch. Buttler goes feeling for it and is beaten on the outside
on a length outside off. Sudharsan takes a step down the track and prods it into the on side via the inside edge
big in-swinger, pitching on a length outside off and finishing on middle. Buttler walks down and tucks it off his pads towards deep square leg
length ball outside off. Buttler gets onto the front foot and pushes it towards extra cover

has that carried?! Looks like it has, and Hinge has sent the GT skipper packing! Full and slanting into off stump. Gill plants his front foot and looks to shovel an on-drive away. Does not get on top of it, and does not get under it enough either. Hits it flat to Klaasen at mid on, who lunges forward and picks it up inches off the turf. GT rocked early!
full and sliding down leg. Gill seems to miss his flick and the ball grazes the pad on its way through to the keeper. Kishan dives to his left but fumbles his collection
miscued but safe! Full on middle and off, and this shapes away late. Gill goes walkabouts and swishes at it, plonking it off the leading edge towards deep backward point
short, wide and punished! Too much width on offer this time. Gill throws his hands at it and crashes it past point. The sweeper had no chance either!
dropped! Very tough chance, though. Full just outside off. Gill brings out the straight drive and hits it uppishly. Nitish gets his right hand up as a reflex action but cannot make it stick
very full outside off and swinging away. Sudharsan, having taken a step down the track, jams it out behind square on the leg side
full on leg stump and this seems to stick in the surface. Sudharsan checks his shot and still the ball nearly carries to mid on
lovely! Searching full delivery outside off and Sudharsan makes the most of it. He leans into the drive and times it sweetly between mid off and extra cover!
back of a length on middle and leg, bowled at 140.1kph. A bit of extra bounce and Gill stabs it towards mid wicket
angled in on a length on middle and off. Gill presses half forward and taps it gently towards mid wicket
back of a length on middle and leg. Sudharsan gets up on his toes and tucks it off his pads towards deep backward square leg
much fuller on middle and leg. Sudharsan gets onto the front foot and flicks it between mid on and mid wicket. Back for another brace
on a length on the pads. Sudharsan rolls his wrists and helps it behind square. Puts on his skates too and hares back for the second
fullish on middle and leg. Sudharsan comes onto the front foot and prods it back to the bowler

stumped by an absolute mile, and GT have won by an absolute landslide too! SRH consigned to their lowest-ever total, and GT have demolished their fellow playoff contenders to go top! Another wrong'un, dragged back a little on leg. Hinge advances, swings for the hills and misses. Buttler collects and whips off the bails, and that is the cue for the fireworks to go off. GT have blown SRH out of the water, and they now make it five consecutive wins for only the second time in their IPL history!
googly on a back of a length on leg, and this spins in. Hinge swipes at it and misses to get pinged on the body
darted in full just outside leg. Malinga looks for the sweep but is late on it, with the ball rolling off his pad behind square
jammed in towards the stumps this time. Hinge continues swinging and shanks it to long on
starts off with a full toss outside off. Hinge, haring down, throws everything at it and slices it over extra cover
full just outside off. Malinga opens his bat face and dabs it towards backward point
zinged in full outside off. Malinga, with his feet stuck to concrete, swishes at it and misses

another miscue, and Cummins bites the dust too! GT almost there now. Hard length just outside off. Cummins swings himself off his feet and skews it off the leading edge. The ball hangs in the air for an eternity and when it does come down, Siraj is placed at deep third to snaffle it up. SRH nine down!
banged in shorter outside off and with more conviction. Cummins swipes at it but is beaten for pace
Cummins goes all the way now! Back of a length on the stumps and this sits up a bit. Cummins clears his front hip and smears it over cow corner!
Cummins with a few more potentially NRR-salvaging runs! Back of a length on middle and leg. Cummins gives himself some room and shovels it to long on's right!
pushed in full on the pads. Hinge tucks it towards deep square leg. Sets off for the run but gets sent back by his skipper mid-way
another short ball outside off, although this is wider. Hinge continues swinging like a rusty gate and misses
banged in short on off, and this skips through. Hinge has a wild swipe at it and misses
angled in full outside off. Hinge comes half forward and pokes it into the off side

a chip off the glove, and Holder has three too! Full toss outside off. Shivang, rather ambitiously, pre-meditates the scoop. Gets down low enough but he cannot make proper contact. The ball spoons up off the glove and Buttler dives forward to his left to send Shivang on his way!
back of a length on middle and leg. Cummins gets up on his toes and pats it towards deep mid wicket
full toss on the stumps. Shivang tugs it enough to long on's right and keeps strike
angled in on a length on middle and off. Shivang plants his front foot and shanks it over mid off. Back for a couple of runs
hard length on off. Shivang gets up on his toes and stabs it into the off side
back of a length outside off. Cummins gets on top of the bounce and punches it towards deep point
Cummins is still fighting! Banged half-way down outside off and this sits up. Cummins gets his front foot out of the way and wallops it over mid wicket!
back of a length on off. Cummins hangs back and prods it into the off side
bumper outside off. Shivang thinks about the pull for a moment before bailing out of it
dug in short outside off. Shivang gets up on his toes and hacks it to mid on

sliced to backward point, and catch Holder if you can now! GT on the prowl, and SRH sliding! Back of a length outside off and this kicks up just a shade. Nitish tries to punch it through the off side but gets it too much behind point, which brings Sundar, who is in very tight, into play at backward point. He moves smartly to his left and does the rest, and GT have SRH seven down inside 11 overs!

Holder appeals, but gets met with a wide call! Length ball sneaking down leg. Nitish looks to tickle it fine and seems to miss it. Holder thinks otherwise. He reckons the ball has brushed something, and Gill has reviewed. The review is for a wide, by the way. The pad is nowhere near, so if there is something, it has to be off the bat. Clear gap there too, and the wide call stays. GT lose a review!
length ball on middle and leg. Nitish gets onto the front foot and works it through the mid wicket region for a couple of runs
back of a length outside off. Cummins hangs back and dabs it past backward point to open his account

a massive top edge, and Klaasen perishes too! And is that the game?! Back of a length on off and this seems to stick in the surface. Klaasen looks to tug it leg-side but the extra bounce, plus the lack of pace, means the ball loops up off the leading/top edge. Buttler calls early, runs back to his left and tumbles to complete the catch. Holder is overjoyed, and this might be the final nail in SRH's coffin for the night!
pushed in on a length just outside off. Nitish presses half forward and stabs it towards mid wicket
back of a length outside off. Nitish gets up on his toes and jabs it towards extra cover

edged and taken! Arora falls, and Prasidh is into the wicket-taking act too! Back of a length outside off and this moves away off the pitch. Arora goes nibbling at it and gets a healthy nick that Buttler snares to his right. SRH lose their fifth, and GT tighten their grip on this contest!
shortish outside off. Arora gets on top of the bounce and dabs it towards backward point
safe again! Back of a length outside off and this kicks up. Klaasen hangs his bat out and plonks it towards backward point
slanted in on a length on middle and leg. Arora knocks it to long on and keeps things ticking
back of a length just outside off. Arora hops around his crease before prodding it to long on to keep strike
back of a length, angling into the stumps. Klaasen tucks it off his pads towards deep square leg
back of a length, pitching just outside off and nipping in. Klaasen hangs back and pokes it towards the bowler
angled in full outside off. Klaasen gets forward and pushes it towards mid off
back of a length just outside off, and this nips back in. Klaasen hops around his crease and chunks it into the mid wicket region
four more! Back of a length, but sliding into the pads. Klaasen gets inside the line and glances it neatly into the fine leg fence!
more streaky runs! Back of a length outside off and this hurtles through too. Arora dangles his bat and the ball flies off the outside edge past deep third!
hard length, zoning into the stumps. Nothing to work with for Arora and he pats it into the off side

ball hits the stumps, but the bails do not fall off! Back of a length just outside off. Arora has a tentative prod at it and jams it into his body. The ball then rolls onto the stumps but not enough velocity to kick the bails off!
edged but safe! Banged in short just outside off. Klaasen has a hack at it and the ball swirls agonizingly over the keeper's head
into the blockhole outside off. Klaasen jams down on it and slices it out to backward point
back of a length just outside off. Klaasen gets up on his toes and pushes it back to the bowler
top shot, but not the greatest of efforts in the field! Full outside off. Arora presses forward and times it beautifully. Gill gives chase from mid off but cannot pull it back into play!
back of a length just outside off. Arora, hopping around his crease, jabs at it and chunks it off the inside edge into his body
Arora with his first boundary! Holder errs in line and strays onto the pads. Arora gets forward and clips it neatly between deep backward square leg and deep mid wicket!
back of a length outside off. Arora wants to tip and run to backward point but Klaasen is not quite on the same page
back of a length outside off and this climbs through steeply. Arora wafts at it but is beaten by the extra lift
angled in on a length on off. Klaasen comes forward and knocks it to long on
back of a length outside off. Arora gets on top of the bounce and punches it towards cover point, who slides to his left and takes the sting out of the stroke

popped straight to mid off, and Rabada has three! Slot ball just outside off and Smaran's eyes light up. He does not quite get under it, though, and offers Gill the simplest of catches. Rabada is delighted, as are those clad in GT colours in the stands, and SRH sink further into trouble!
hard length just outside off. Klaasen hops around his crease and stabs it into the mid wicket region

Siraj misjudges it, and Smaran survives! Banged in short on leg stump. Smaran swipes at it and miscues it slightly. Siraj does not pick it initially at deep backward square leg and has to lunge forward right at the end. May not have carried owing to Siraj's misjudgment
back of a length on middle and leg. Smaran hops up onto his toes and blocks
jaffa! Back of a length on middle and leg, and this jags away. Smaran is squared up completely and sees the ball whistle past his bat
back of a length outside off. Smaran uses the pace and dabs it towards deep backward point
slanted across on a length outside off. Smaran tries to force it through the off side and scuffs it towards extra cover
back of a length on middle and leg. Smaran hangs back in his crease and defends
fullish just outside off. Smaran reaches out for this a little and nearly plonks it to point
back of a length just outside off. Smaran lets the ball come to him before meeting it close to his body
back of a length outside off. Kisses the surface and seams away. Smaran, feeling for it away from his body, is beaten. A bit of extra bounce too, based on the batter's reaction
back of a length, zoning into middle and off. Klaasen hops up onto his toes and plays it back to the bowler
another sumptuous shot through the off side! Klaasen this time. Back of a length outside off and he rises with the bounce to caress it between extra cover and mid off!
hard length, nipping back in towards off. Klaasen hangs back and pokes it towards the bowler
full outside off. Smaran uses the angle and opens his bat face to glide it towards deep backward point
back of a length outside off. Klaasen gets on top of the bounce and guides it down to deep third

nicked and gone! Some Rabada redemption in Ahmedabad, and SRH are in freefall! Back of a length in the channel and this zips through. A bit of nip away too and Kishan, cramped for room on the cut, only manages to feather it through to the keeper. GT have three inside four overs, and SRH are reeling!
back of a length just outside off. Kishan opens his bat face late and dabs it down to deep backward point
just beyond Rabada! Slot ball on off. Kishan winds up and powers it just over a leaping Rabada at mid on. Rabada might have been beaten for pace there!
length ball on middle and off. Kishan comes onto the front foot and pushes it towards extra cover
back of a length just outside off. Smaran rides the bounce and runs it down to deep third
back of a length just outside off. Smaran hangs back and pats it into the off side
shot! Full just outside off, shaping back in. Smaran gets onto the front foot and threads it between extra cover and mid off!
Kishan lands his first blow! No punches being pulled here! In the slot on the pads and Kishan does not miss out. He gets forward and whips it a mile over deep square leg!
full and pushed across the batter outside off. Smaran goes searching for it and edges it down to deep third

chopped on in the most freakish of manners, and Rabada roars back! Shortish and following the batter as he steps outside leg. Abhishek looks to defend but the extra pace means that he only manages to dab it onto his stumps. What a moment. Abhishek cannot believe it. But the crowd believes now. SRH rocked twice in two overs, and this game is turning!
back of a length outside off. Abhishek hangs back and meets the ball right under his eyes

oh! On a length just outside leg and this jags away sharply. Abhishek, stepping down and backing away, looks to go inside-out and misses. Ball wobbled a great deal after passing the stumps and Buttler did well to get something on it
oh, hello! Why do we even bother asking! Abhishek is going to play only one way! Fullish outside off. Abhishek plants his front foot and launches it over mid off!
back of a length outside off. Kishan gets up on his toes and pats it into the off side. Wicket-maiden to start for Siraj
back of a length on off, shaping back in. Kishan stays leg side of the ball and taps it into the off side

off the leading edge, and caught at deep backward point! Dream over by Siraj, and now the dream start for GT! Siraj has had Head on toast throughout the over, and now he has his reward. Back of a length on leg. Shapes away and Head gets turned inside out. Looks to flick it away but all he does is find the sweeper via the leading edge.
